mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 2% MoM and the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months but the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines, but the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a potential pause in tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases during a tightening cycle but the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.
